scope: Fresh live mechanics frontier after Batch 457 over the 474-record canonical skill corpus.
method: Recomputed registered current-evidence-audit coverage and selected the next shortest remaining records by combined mechanics_notes/notes detail. Eight records were rechecked against current Xenoverse 2-specific references and independent corroboration.

records.mechanics_notes: 500-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from PQ109. The opening pseudo-strike punch is followed by a pink Kamehameha beam; current dedicated evidence documents 25 hits and about 40% total damage. The initial punch is slower than the standard Super Black Kamehameha, while the beam carries the stronger damage portion. Exact frame data and reward probability remain unresolved.

400-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from PQ76. The user charges a Kamehameha, teleports to the locked-on opponent, then fires for 24 hits and about 30% source-reported damage. The repository retains conflicting reward-tier evidence and therefore does not assert a new Ultimate Finish gate. Exact teleport timing and frame data remain unresolved.

300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from Expert Mission 8. The user jumps upward and rains Ki Blasts downward in a long-range, 21-hit projectile sequence with knockback and about 30% source-reported total damage. Community usage notes are kept separate from deterministic mechanics.

500-Ki Saiyan-only Awoken Skill. Current evidence confirms level 90+ plus max Whis friendship for acquisition, +25% all attack damage, 5% damage reduction, and 10 Ki drain per second; charged Ki attacks gain the Super Saiyan teleport/vanish behavior. Exact movement/frame and stamina interactions remain unresolved.

300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from Expert Mission 11. The user launches a large tracked Ki wave with long-range coverage; current dedicated evidence documents 17 hits, knockback, and about 40% total damage. Existing EM11 acquisition semantics remain unchanged; exact drop probability and frame data remain unresolved.

100-Ki Ki Blast Super from PQ77. Creates a short-range omnidirectional purple explosion; holding the input spends additional Ki and permits repeated/extended explosions up to four Ki bars total. Official update notes document the historical reduction from 200 to 100 Ki and a damage increase; exact modern frame data and universal damage scaling remain unresolved.

300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate sold in the TP Medal Shop for 200 TP Medals. The user floats for about 2 seconds, releases a large area explosion, and can hold the input to consume Stamina and extend it; dedicated evidence reports a 20-hit base sequence at about 30% damage and leaves the user vulnerable afterward. Exact extended damage and frame data remain unresolved.

100-Ki Ki Blast Super from PQ128. The user fires a single projectile in an outward arc; backward input fires it behind the user. Current repository evidence records about 5% damage and a damaged-state activation that can spend up to 300 Stamina. Exact activation timing and damage scaling remain unresolved.
